title: Invasion Protocol
description:
You’re not the hero. You’re the invasion.Drop onto a hostile bug-infested planet as skull-helmeted soldiers and execute Invasion Protocol.

• Choose from unique classes, the regular Soldier, Officer, War Engineer, Infiltrator, Explosives Expert, or Zoner. Each with completely different abilities and playstyles.

• Aim and fire at the same time in fast, brutal top-down combat, no cover, no waiting, just pure trigger discipline

• Blast through procedurally linked levels and complete dynamic objectives: defend a base, hunt a brood queen, repair a drop-ship, or exterminate everything

• Return tech items for War Points, to radio for more firepower

• Swap weapons and abilities on the fly from weapon crates and call-in radio

• Survive escalating swarms, mutations, and massive bosses

• Unlock new classes, devastating weapons, and game changing abilities after every run

Fast, chaotic, and ridiculously replayable a roguelite shooter where you are the final boss the planet never wanted. Execute the protocol.
description_short: You’re not the hero, you’re the invasion. Drop in as skull-helmeted soldiers and obliterate a bug-infested planet. Choose your class, aim & fire non-stop, complete brutal objectives, and swap weapons & abilities on the fly. Unlock new classes and gear as you go. Execute the protocol.
